Case Study.Title: Pinku Social Media Boost
Case Study.Sub Title: EcoFarm leveraged our social media strategies, resulting in increased brand awareness and a growing online community.
Case Study.Content:
RetailRev, a mid-sized e-commerce shop focusing on home and lifestyle goodies, was struggling with flat online sales even though their website was getting plenty of visitors. Their marketing and sales teams weren't on the same page, and campaigns were getting held up because of manual tasks and a lack of system integration.


The Challenge, huh?


Before switching to Bartoon, GrowthSpark’s sales crew was bogged down with outdated spreadsheets, a mishmash of CRM tools, and a lot of manual work. Leads were slipping through the cracks, their pipeline was a mess, and follow-ups were hit or miss. It’s no surprise their close rates weren’t getting any better and the sales reps were feeling pretty fed up.


Here's the Solution!


RetailRev teamed up with Trilo to boost their marketing game and automate their sales processes. In just a few weeks, Trilo rolled out some awesome changes that really ramped up their operations and efficiency.


  • Created dashboards to monitor activity and conversions.

  • Consolidated lead data into an easy-to-use platform.

  • Tailored pipeline stages to fit their sales process.

  • Allowed sales reps and managers to monitor deals in real-time.

  • Streamlined follow-ups, reminders, and lead nurturing.

Blog.Title: Email Marketing Effective Best Practices and Tips
Blog.Sub Title: Effective email campaigns boost conversions. Learn the key elements of impactful newsletters.
Blog.Content:
InnovateSphere, a burgeoning tech firm specializing in AI-driven solutions, noticed their marketing ROI was unclear despite numerous campaigns. Their data was siloed, making it difficult to measure the true impact of each marketing channel.


The Problem?


Before switching to Bartoon, the marketing team at GrowthSpark relied on a mix of outdated analytics tools, making it tough to get a clear picture of campaign performance. Key metrics were often overlooked, leading to wasted ad spend and missed opportunities for optimization. Consequently, their marketing efforts lacked the precision needed to drive significant growth.


The Winning Tactic!


InnovateSphere partnered with Trilo to implement a comprehensive marketing analytics strategy. Within weeks, Trilo helped them consolidate their data sources, identify key performance indicators (KPIs), and automate reporting. This gave InnovateSphere real-time insights into their marketing performance, enabling them to make data-driven decisions and optimize their campaigns for maximum impact.


The Real Issue?


Before they switched to Bartoon, GrowthSpark’s marketing team struggled with fragmented data and a lack of clear metrics. They couldn’t accurately track campaign performance, leading to inefficient spending and missed opportunities. As a result, their marketing strategies were more guesswork than informed action.

Career.Title: QA Tester
Career.Author: Innovatech
Career.Content:
Job Overview


We're on the lookout for a talented Senior UI/UX Designer to take the lead in crafting user-friendly and stylish experiences for both web and mobile platforms. As a key player in our design team, you'll help shape the future of our product, mentor junior designers, and collaborate closely with various teams to create innovative user-focused solutions.


What You Need

  • 5 years in UI/UX design, showcasing your product design journey.

  • Expertise in design software like Figma.

  • A solid grasp of user-centered design, responsive layouts, and accessibility best practices.

  • Experience in user research and usability testing.

  • Great communication and presentation skills to share your design ideas and choices.

  • Ability to juggle user needs, business goals, and technical limitations.

  • Experience in agile product teams is a bonus.


What We Bring to the Table

  • A competitive salary and a solid benefits package.

  • Flexible hours and a culture that supports remote work.

  • Opportunities for career advancement and leadership roles.

  • A collaborative and design-focused work atmosphere.

  • Access to top-notch tools and learning resources.
